introHtml: Gray pedometers offer a neutral, professional look that blends seamlessly with corporate apparel or fitness kits. Whether you're outfitting a company wellness challenge or distributing step counters at a health fair, gray keeps the focus on function without competing with brand colors. These devices typically feature a clip-on design, large LCD display, and simple reset button. Imprint your logo via pad printing or laser engraving for a clean, lasting mark that employees will use daily.
